register: Elenco regionale Alberi monumentali d'Italia - Sardegna
authority: Regione Autonoma della Sardegna, Corpo Forestale e di Vigilanza Ambientale (CFVA)
licence_proof: GeoNetwork metadata record R_SARDEG:2c6bc878-6ce3-4a9d-bea4-966775c38a70 (layer dbu:alberi_monumentali_2022_07_26), legalConstraints field: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 . Confirmed 2026-08-28 via https://webgis2.regione.sardegna.it/geonetwork API search, superseding the 2026-08-17 'licence not found this pass' entry in data/register-scouting.json.
notes: Same legal framework as Sicily/Piemonte/Puglia's Italian monumental-tree registers (Legge 10/2013, DM 23/10/2014), regional layer dated 26.07.2022, 405 records total. No age field, same as MASAF and every other Italian regional import so far; girth_cm and height_m are present for nearly every record and support a DERIVED age estimate per CLAUDE.md's growth-rate rule, never a bridged one. Coordinates reprojected server-side from EPSG:3003 to EPSG:4326 via the WFS srsName param (verified against the untransformed x/y pair in properties). tutela carries the protecting decree, useful as the register's own second-hand citation but not an independent second source on its own.
